description:
• Brand introduction: Nirvana helps people transform their bodies at a cellular level with a line of Nirvana Super™ wellness beverages infused with a unique, multi-patented life-enhancing super ingredient backed by science. Our team is comprised of world-renowned scientists, physicians, athletes, marketers, food scientists and operators working together to bring revolutionary products to consumers  that integrate seamlessly into any wellness routine.
  • Product description: Nirvana Super(tm) products have a proven hero ingredient, HMB. HMB (β-hydroxy β-methylbutyrate) is produced naturally in our bodies during the metabolism of the essential amino acid leucine, and is needed to protect and repair muscle tissue. Why supplement with HMB? Under the age of 30, HMB optimizes muscle mass. Over the age of 30, HMB helps you maintain muscle mass. The discovery of HMB as a natural supplement is revolutionary because we can’t eat enough protein to reverse age related or disease related muscle wasting. To get an effective amount of HMB, a person would have to consume 600g** daily (10X the recommended daily dose*) of high-quality protein, which is not possible.

  • USP (Unique Selling Point):
  • 30+ years of research and development backed by $500,000,000 in National Institute of Health funding.

  • HMB has been proven to:
    • Promotes lean muscle mass and metabolism
    • Increases maximum oxygen consumption during physical activity (VO2)
    • Reduces recovery time and muscle soreness

  • Water sourced from the Adirondack mountains: Located in the foothills of the Adirondack Mountains, Nirvana’s vertically integrated water bottling facility spans 1,700 acres of pristine wilderness and sits on top of two of the largest aquifers in the Northeast United States. The property has a virtually unlimited supply of highly sought after pure mountain spring water with five New York State certified springs and over twenty additional undeveloped springs.

  • Payment terms: As a Super Affiliate, you will be paid on the 5th of each month for the previous month of revenue.

PROGRAM DETAILS

· Platform Enrollment: All Affiliates must enroll in Nirvana Super’s™ Affiliate Program. Nirvana’s Affiliate Team will assess your social media accounts and place you in one of our Affiliate tiers:

· Beginner Affiliate

· Affiliate

· Advanced Affiliate

· Product: Your product discount and/or allotment will be determined by your Affiliate tier. Note that free product (or merchandise) provided to an Affiliate cannot be returned for cash or credit.

· Promo Code: You will receive a unique discount code and link for your community to use on feelsuper.com (or an alternative URL should the Nirvana Super™ website be modified).

· Whitelisting Access: We believe in the power of your content and would like to spend money behind mutually agreed upon content created within the Affiliate program. This will give you and Nirvana Super™ more eyeballs on your account and our mutual content. Here is how you give Nirvana Super™ access to whitelist advertise on your account.

Whitelisting on Meta (Facebook/IG)

The creator must have a Meta Business Account

Steps to Gain Access to Creator Account

· The creator logs into their Meta Business Manager

· Facebook Business Manager > Business Settings > Users > tap Partners.

· Then, tap the Add dropdown > select Give a partner access to your asset.

· Enter the brand’s Facebook Business Manager ID, <819828685235112> tap Next.

· Choose the Facebook Page and Instagram Account Assets the brand will use for whitelisting.

· Grant us access to Pixels to help us build custom audiences that match our target customer demographics

Whitelisting on Tik Tok

The creator must enable Ad Authorization and share the code with Nirvana Super™

Steps to Gain Access to Creator Account

· Creator will go to TikTok account settings.

· Select “Creator Tools” and turn “Ad Settings” on.

· Enable “Ad Authorization” (this prompts the creator to authorize content for promotion).

· After selecting a time frame, tap “Authorize”.

· This is also when you will generate the post code and share with Nirvana Super™.

MONTHLY DELIVERABLES

· 2 stories on your personal social media account(s) featuring a bottle of any Nirvana Super™ beverage.

· 1 post + 1 reel / video OR 2 reels / videos on your personal social media account(s) featuring a bottle of any Nirvana Super™ beverage or Nirvana Super™ gear. Note: If Nirvana Super™ produces the content, you can accept collaborative posts from Nirvana Super™ that will appear in your social media feed.

· Tag: @nirvanasuper

· Required FTC compliance hashtags: #nirvanaambassador or #sponsored clearly in every post. If using multiple hashtags, make sure this one comes first.

· Required Nirvana hashtags: #feelsuper #nirvanasuper

· Product related hashtags:

· Nirvana Super™ HMB-infused products: #HMB #musclehealth #musclewellness

· Nirvana Spring electrolyte-infused products: #electrolytes #hydration and #superhydration

INCENTIVES % of Sales on Nirvana Super™ Shots

· Promo Code: You will receive a unique 15% discount code for your community to use on nirvanawatersciences.com (or an alternative URL should the Nirvana website be modified).

· Standard Pay-out: Our standard starter commission is 20% on all products sold using your promo code, adjusted for any refunds or returns.

% of Sales on Nirvana Super™ Waters and Seltzers, Nirvana Spring Waters and Merchandise

· Promo Code: You will receive a unique 15% discount code for your community to use on nirvanawatersciences.com (or an alternative URL should the Nirvana website be modified).

· Standard Pay-out: Our standard starter commission is 10% on all products sold using your promo code, adjusted for any refunds or returns.

SPIFFs

· SPIFF, Revenue Targets: You will receive a $50 SPIFF per $500 revenue marker.

· SPIFF, Unique Retailers: We offer a $100 SPIFF* per new retailer you open the door for Nirvana Super™ products. *You qualify for a SPIFF once the retailer has ordered ten (10) 12-pack cases of any Nirvana Super™ or Nirvana Spring products.

· Quarterly Affiliate Competitions: We will run quarterly Affiliate competitions for premium merchandise and experiences.

COMPLIANCE

Nirvana Super™ takes compliance seriously, and expects its Affiliates to take compliance seriously too. Accordingly, Affiliates will be expected to:

· Participate in a minimum of one training/compliance session per year to learn more about Nirvana Super™, its products, and compliance best practices.

· Review and comply with the Federal Trade Commission’s Guides Concerning the Use of Endorsements and Testimonials in Advertising.

· Submit all social media posts to Nirvana Super™ for approval prior to publication.

Affiliate understands and agrees that Nirvana Super™ may (i) monitor Affiliate’s social media throughout the term of service for compliance; and (ii) require that Affiliate edit, modify, or remove any and all social media posts at any time for any reason. Affiliate shall immediately edit, modify, or remove any social media post at Nirvana’s request and according to any instructions Nirvana Super may provide as soon as practicable, but in no event more than twenty-four (24) hours after such request.

ACTIVE SOCIAL CHANNELS*

· Instagram

· Facebook

· TikTok

· Twitter

· Linkedin

· Pinterest

*Any content created through our Affiliate Program can be used on any / all Nirvana social
